figures.Fig31.6: Fractional distillation of crude oil into useful hydrocarbons (PDF page 225). Original figure archived as c12-chem-ch31-fig-distillation (drawn for this lesson after the printed figure; not the textbook's picture). The printed figure gives kerosene the formula C10H14, which is not an alkane; drawn as C10H22 (decane, an alkane in the kerosene range).

findings: The gasoline range is printed as '<40 C - 200 C' and is carried as printed. The Quick Check questions are printed without answers; the lesson's answers were derived for it and need the second-person review.
